task.description: Produce a Type E design artifact for EXP-601 central tier-to-quota enforcement in kernel middleware. Write src/design/exp601_tier_quota_model.md with: (1) quota taxonomy (script CPU/memory, entity storage, file quota, concurrent sandboxes, retry budget), (2) single configuration surface schema and ownership, (3) middleware enforcement flow and error taxonomy, (4) integration points in src/api/middleware/* and src/config/*, (5) acceptance traceability to EXP-601 criteria, (6) migration/compatibility notes for existing tenant types. Do not write implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All EXP-601 acceptance criteria mapped to design elements
No implementation code in design artifact
Public interfaces and dependencies are explicit
Error taxonomy included for quota exceed cases

result.summary: Produced Type E design for EXP-601 central tier-to-quota enforcement in kernel middleware, including quota taxonomy, single config surface, middleware flow, error taxonomy, integration points, acceptance traceability, and compatibility/migration guidance.
